note: expected is the worst outcome of the normal pass (a string, or one per viewport width); rules lists its measurements.rule values. text-200 is the 200% text-scale pass (ids end in -200); unlisted elements must be none there. A finding counts for a label when its selector is the id or starts with '<id> > '.

#banner.note: White on #222: readable. It is the cover, not the covered.

#covered.note: Under the fixed banner. Reported once as covered; the contrast sampler would also fail it (dark text over the dark banner), but that finding is suppressed.

#under-clear-overlay.note: A transparent layer sits on top but paints nothing.

#link-para.note: The hit test lands on its own link: a descendant, not a cover.

#photo-caption.note: White over pale sky and dark hills: varied background.

#email.note: Regression: the coolgirlmath.com sign-in field. #595659 on rgba(255,249,245,.85) is about 7:1; the old sampler read the rgb(138,125,118) border and reported 1.82:1.

#placeholder-faint.note: Empty field: the colour comes from ::placeholder (#c8c8c8), not the field's dark text colour.

#skip-link.note: Entirely off screen on purpose (a skip link), not partly cut.

#wide-table.note: Wider than the screen, but inside an overflow-x:auto container.
